Who can register a .app domain?
Anyone. There are no eligibility requirements, so solo developers, startups, and global brands can all register a .app domain for their product.
Do I need an SSL certificate for a .app domain?
Yes. Every .app domain is on the HSTS preload list, which means browsers will only load .app sites over a secure HTTPS connection. Your site needs an SSL certificate before it will load. Many registrars and hosting providers include one, and free certificates are widely available.

excerpts.title: AI Chatbot Development Cost 2026: Complete Guide
excerpts.text: Where the chatbot lives affects costs. Web-based deployment is straightforward. Mobile app integration requires separate iOS and Android development. Omnichannel deployment across web, mobile, WhatsApp, Facebook Messenger, and SMS multiplies technical requirements. Cloud infrastructure choices matter. According to Google Cloud documentation, for a chatbot handling 100,000 daily interactions with an average of 1,000 input characters and 500 output characters per interaction, the cost is approximately $3.75 per day for input processing at $0.0375 per million characters, plus $7.50 per day for output at $0.15 per million characters. That’s roughly $112.50 monthly for input processing alone at that volume ($3.75/day × 30 days), plus approximately $225 monthly for output processing ($7.50/day × 30 days), for a total of approximately $337.50 monthly. Scale to a million interactions daily, and costs multiply proportionally.

excerpts.title: AI Chatbot Development Cost 2026: Complete Guide
excerpts.text: Overview: AI chatbot development costs range from $3,000 for basic rule-based bots to over $1 million for enterprise-grade custom solutions. The total investment depends on chatbot type (rule-based, NLP-driven, or LLM-powered), feature complexity, integration requirements, and ongoing maintenance needs. According to Google Cloud data, operational costs for a chatbot handling 100,000 daily interactions can run approximately $3.75 for input processing and additional output costs, while development expenses vary significantly by region and expertise level. The chatbot market reached $7.76 billion in 2024 and is projected to hit $27.29 billion by 2030. That’s explosive growth. But here’s what matters more: understanding exactly what it’ll cost to build one for your business. The pricing landscape is complicated. A simple FAQ bot might run a few thousand dollars, while an enterprise-grade conversational AI platform can push seven figures. This isn’t about finding the cheapest option. It’s about matching investment to capability, understanding where money actually goes, and avoiding the hidden expenses that derail budgets.
